name: Aberdeen Full Moon Trail — 11 km or 21 km
description: Join the monthly Full Moon Trail for hikers, runners and cyclists. Entry R200 per person. Assemble at Aberdeen Self Catering at 19:00; depart at 20:00. Halfway: De Kruis Farm Stay at 22:00; destination: Wynberg Guest Farm at 01:00 on Sunday. Entry includes coffee or tea at the start, halfway and finish, Sunday breakfast (coffee, oats, hot dogs and rusks), camping spot with hot showers (bring your own tent and bedding), and return transport. Other accommodation is available. Bring your own backpack with snacks, drinks and a strong headlamp (compulsory). Luggage can be loaded onto the support vehicle at departure. No medical support on the route. Sign the register and indemnity. Light meals and snacks are for sale at the start and finish. Accommodation enquiries: Aberdeen Self Catering 082 799 0788; De Kruis 084 498 2740; Wynberg Guest Farm 082 723 0025.
